88forn: Quentin "Ghost" Forn came up the line in the rain with a child's drawing of a horse and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Quentin "Ghost" Forn wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A parcel came for Quentin "Ghost" Forn that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
At the Chalk Pits, Quentin "Ghost" Forn of the Hegemony and Albin Zgz of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F8. Quentin "Ghost" Forn was the only one they could still help, and only just. Quentin "Ghost" Forn was killed outright by a direct hit at R-F8. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
The House of Forn sent Matthias "Rabbit" Forn after Quentin "Ghost" Forn. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
filip_ogwanga: Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga came from Ashford Vale, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga held the mirror while Ulrich Asher shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The order named Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
